leftEvidence.title: A new covenant after a broken one

points.label: Former covenant
points.left: Jeremiah contrasts the new covenant with the one made at the Exodus.
points.right: Hebrews repeats that contrast in quotation.

points.label: Law
points.right: Quoted as laws placed in mind and written on heart.

points.label: Forgiveness
points.left: Iniquity forgiven and sin remembered no more.
points.right: The same promise is quoted as part of the covenant argument.

payload.posture: Allow the quotation to remain visible so the reader can distinguish Jeremiah’s wording from Hebrews’ framing.

rightEvidence.title: Jeremiah’s new covenant quoted at length

payload.tension: Hebrews quotes Jeremiah’s new-covenant promise while framing it within an argument about a better ministry and the aging of the first covenant.
payload.title: Promise / quotation
